sections.title: 6-NIGHT RAINFOREST WELLNESS & RESET EXPERIENCE
sections.html:
Step away from the demands of everyday life and give yourself room to breathe. Set in the peaceful rainforest, this six-night wellness journey invites adults to slow down, reconnect with nature and make time for their own well-being.

Through nourishing meals, gentle movement, meditation and holistic practices, guests can explore what helps them feel restored. The experience can be guided by a qualified wellness professional and shaped around the interests and needs of the group.

With space for both shared experiences and quiet reflection, the journey offers a chance to return home refreshed, grounded and inspired to carry healthier habits into daily life.

sections.title: Day 1 — Arrive, Exhale, Begin
sections.html: Arrive at San José International Airport, where a private transfer will take you to your rainforest retreat in Costa Rica’s Central Valley, about an hour away. This green region offers a peaceful setting for the week ahead. After checking in, take time to explore the property and settle into the slower pace. An opening circle introduces the group and offers space to set a personal intention, followed by a gentle practice and herbal tea. Later, you’ll learn about the retreat’s approach to wellness and nourishing food before sharing dinner and an evening gathering.

sections.title: Day 2 — Fresh Flavors, Feel-Good Movement
sections.html: Begin the morning with meditation and yoga before breakfast. In a cooking and herbs workshop, discover ingredients used locally and explore simple ways to bring more fresh, flavorful foods into everyday meals. After lunch, the afternoon leaves room to rest, enjoy the rainforest surroundings or join a movement or dance session. Dinner and an informal group gathering round out the day.

sections.title: Day 3 — Reset Your Rhythm
sections.html: After morning meditation and mindful movement, an interactive wellness workshop explores how eating habits, rest and daily routines can affect the way we feel. The emphasis is on finding practical ideas that fit your life at home. Enjoy lunch and some free time before a sound healing session invites you to pause and relax. Gather again over dinner and spend the evening with the group.

sections.title: Day 4 — Waterfall Wishes
sections.html: Start with meditation and breathwork, then head out to a local waterfall for time in Costa Rica’s lush landscape. A guided reflection in nature offers a chance to consider what you’re grateful for and what you’d like to leave behind. After lunch, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at an easy pace. Depending on the group’s interests, there may also be an optional cacao or mindful nature experience before dinner.

sections.title: Day 5 — From Rainforest Canopy to Pacific Sunset
sections.html: Morning meditation and yoga set the tone before a day of adventure. Travel toward Costa Rica’s Pacific coast, stopping for a zipline experience that offers a new view of the rainforest canopy. Then continue to the beach, where you’ll have free time to enjoy the ocean and watch the sunset. Share dinner by the water before returning to your retreat property for the night.

sections.title: Day 6 — Take the Good Home
sections.html: Begin your final full day with meditation, yoga and breakfast. During an herbal wellness workshop, learn more about local plants and make a simple preparation to take home as a reminder of your time in Costa Rica. The afternoon is open for a swim, a walk around the property, quiet rest or an optional wellness treatment. In the evening, come together around a fire for music, reflection and a relaxed celebration of the connections made during the week.

sections.title: Day 7 — One Last Rainforest Morning
sections.html: Enjoy breakfast and a little free time, depending on your flight schedule. A private transfer will take you back to San José International Airport for your departure. Leave with memories of the rainforest and coast, new connections, and wellness practices you can continue at home.

sections.title: Day 9: Carrying Pura Vida Home
sections.html:
Enjoy a final breakfast at the hotel and, time permitting, one last look at the Pacific before beginning the journey home.

Depart Costa Rica feeling renewed by its landscapes, inspired by its commitment to sustainability and enriched by the warmth of its people. The journey may be ending, but the spirit of pura vida—living with gratitude, presence and appreciation for life’s simple pleasures—is something each traveler can carry home.

  • Wellness workshops and educational sessions

  • Sound healing / sound frequency sessions

  • Herbal wellness workshop

  • Nature and waterfall excursion

  • Zipline adventure

  • Pacific beach sunset experience
